Dear {vendor} team,

I am writing to dispute charges on {agreement}. Our order form covers {contracted_seats} seats. Your billing under {invoices} reflects {billed_seats} seats, which is {extra_seats} seats more than we contracted for.

The agreement states: "{increase_requires}". We have not signed an order form increasing our seat count, so the additional seats were not authorized. At {price_per_seat}, the extra seats have resulted in an overcharge of {overcharged_to_date} to date, with {overcharge_monthly} added each month until this is corrected. The annualized amount is {annualized}.

Please issue a credit for the overcharged amount of {overcharged_to_date} and send a corrected bill reflecting {contracted_seats} seats going forward. If we decide to add seats, we will do so through a signed order form.

Please confirm receipt of this dispute and let us know when we can expect the credit and corrected invoice.

Thank you,
{sender}
